ex.zh: 几名军官听到井中传来声响，意识到一头大象被困在井底深处。

ex.en: The noise was powerful enough to shake buildings and set off car alarms.
ex.zh: 噪声强烈到足以震动建筑物，并触发汽车警报。

ex.en: Shopping for food involved mud, noisy chickens, clouds of flies, nasty smells, bargaining, and getting short-changed.
ex.zh: 买菜意味着泥泞、吵闹的鸡、成群的苍蝇、难闻的气味、讨价还价，还可能被少找钱。

ex.en: Let everyone see the noisy, messy deliberations that advance science and lead to decisions that benefit us all.
ex.zh: 让所有人都看看那些喧闹、杂乱的讨论吧：正是这些讨论推动科学进步，并促成让大家受益的决策。

ex.zh: 例如，只在外面放盐、里面不放，就能在不改变味道的情况下减少盐的含量。

ex.en: Of the forces shaping higher education none is more sweeping than the movement across borders.
ex.zh: 在塑造高等教育的各种力量中，没有哪一种比跨国流动带来的影响更广泛。

ex.en: One longtime critic, Les Perelman, has drawn national attention several times for putting together nonsense essays that have fooled software grading programs into giving high marks.
ex.zh: 长期持批评态度的 Les Perelman 曾多次因编造出胡言乱语的文章，骗得作文评分软件给出高分，而引起全美关注。

put up with nonsense｜容忍胡闹

ex.zh: 我昨天在网上填好了订单，中午之前就会送到。

ex.en: For example: a meeting from 9 a.m. to 10 a.m., research from 10 a.m. to noon, etc. On the other hand, task-timers have a list of things they want to accomplish.
ex.zh: 例如，上午9点到10点开会，10点到中午做研究，等等。而以任务安排时间的人则会列出自己想完成的事情。

ex.en: The process seems so normal that we sometimes think of it as a natural part of growing up, but it is not.

ex.zh: Smith 告诉一名记者：“我像平常一样沿着自己的路线走。”

ex.en: The Olympic class ships were built by the Harland & Wolff ship makers in Northern Ireland for the White Star Line company.
ex.zh: 奥林匹克级客轮由北爱尔兰的哈兰德与沃尔夫造船厂为白星航运公司建造。

ex.en: She stayed in the Northwest, although the test could not be more specific than somewhere between eastern Oregon and western Wyoming.
ex.zh: 她一直待在美国西北部，不过检测只能确定她所在的位置在俄勒冈州东部与怀俄明州西部之间，无法更精确。

ex.en: A team with Oxford University's Wildlife Conservation Research Unit, supported by a charity organization, spent two nights in November camping in a national park in northwest Ethiopia on the Ethiopia-Sudan border.
ex.zh: 在一家慈善组织的资助下，牛津大学野生动物保护研究组的一支团队于11月在埃塞俄比亚西北部、埃塞与苏丹边境的一座国家公园里露营了两晚。

tip: 西北风从西北吹来；向西北走用head northwest。
